items.answer: Yes, CittaAI provides dedicated local SEO for Hyderabad businesses, including Google Business Profile optimization, geo-targeted content, local citations, and location-based schema markup to help you rank in "near me" searches and Google Maps.

items.question: Is SEO still worth it with AI tools like ChatGPT changing search?
items.answer: SEO is more important than ever, since the same technical and content foundation that ranks you on Google is also what determines whether AI tools cite and recommend your brand — ignoring SEO now risks losing visibility across both channels.

items.question: Are your SEO services customized?
items.answer: Yes, every SEO strategy at CittaAI is tailored to your industry, target audience, and business goals — there's no one-size-fits-all package, since keyword opportunity and competitive landscape differ for every business.

items.question: Do you integrate SEO with AEO and GEO for AI-powered search?
items.answer: Yes, CittaAI integrates traditional SEO with AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — ensuring your brand is not only ranked on Google, but also cited and recommended by AI assistants like ChatGPT and Gemini.
